I will give you an IELTS mock speaking exam using the current questions and will give you an IELTS Band score and evaluation.

Please choose the 45-minute lesson. I am required by iTalki to offer a 60-minute lesson, but I don't want you to choose it. That's why it's so much more expensive than my 45-minute lesson. I want to be able to have a short break between classes.

Please choose a time that starts on the hour (for example: 8:00) and not a time that starts on the half hour.

PLEASE NOTE that I don't usually use the video function when I teach. I don't need to see you, only hear you. I prefer to teach using my phone, which I hold in my hand and sometimes put down on my desk. I don't want to make you feel like you are on a boat in the ocean when I'm giving you a lesson! The only time I use the video is if you insist that you need to see me so that it feels more like a real exam. If this is your situation, please let me know in advance so I can be prepared. 

If you are from China I will send you a message asking you to add me on WeChat. I prefer using WeChat with Chinese students. If you are not from China I prefer to use the iTalki classroom.

pro_course_detail.title: (English for beginners) Inglés para principiantes
pro_course_detail.description:
This comprehensive ESL course is structured to take students from beginner to high-beginner proficiency.  By completing this course, students will gain confidence in speaking, listening, reading, and writing in English, preparing them for real-world communication.  

The course focuses on:  
- **Grammar**: Progressing from basic structures (*be verbs*, *present simple*, *past simple*, *future (going to)*) to more complex structures (*can/can't, comparatives, superlatives, present perfect*).  
- **Vocabulary**: Covering a wide range of topics, including numbers, nationalities, family, food, daily routines, and more.  
- **Pronunciation**: Emphasizing key English sounds, stress patterns, and rhythm to develop clear spoken communication.  
- **Speaking & Listening**: Engaging activities, dialogues, and real-life conversations to improve fluency and comprehension.  
- **Reading & Writing**: Practicing sentence structure, reading comprehension, and writing tasks ranging from simple messages to structured paragraphs.  
- **Practical English**: Everyday functional language, such as ordering food, asking for directions, making small talk, and handling real-world situations.  
- **Cultural Awareness & Communication**: Exploring cultural differences in communication, idiomatic expressions, and social norms.  
- **Review & Progress Checks**: Regular revision exercises and practical challenges to reinforce learning and track progress.

This course is designed for students who want to refine their English skills and achieve a higher level of fluency and accuracy.

 The lessons focus on:

- **Expanded Vocabulary & Expressions**: Learning idiomatic expressions, phrasal verbs, and specialized vocabulary for different contexts.  
- **Pronunciation & Intonation**: Developing a natural rhythm and clarity in speech through stress and intonation practice.

pro_course_detail.title: Scenes & Monologues (Theatre Class)
pro_course_detail.description:
Recite a monologue or perform a scene with me and gain acting skills and self-confidence all while improving your English! In this structured class, you'll learn to act, build vocabulary, improve pronunciation and intonation, and work on expressing your character's emotions through your voice, facial expressions, body language, and gestures. No previous performance experience is necessary - all performance levels are welcome! 

📖 NOTE 1: This class requires reading, writing, speaking, and listening skills.

📝 NOTE 2: You will have homework at the end of every lesson. 

🎭 NOTE 3: It usually takes 3 lessons to complete a script, because we will be adding new 
      skills and theatre terminology to the script each time we meet. 

👩🏽‍🏫 NOTE 4: All materials will be provided, however, you're always welcome to bring in your 
      own! If you're interested in this option, please message me in advance, or ask me for 
      details in class.

pro_course_detail.title: Poems & Short Stories (Reading Class)
pro_course_detail.description:
Practice being an expressive reader, by using your unique voice to bring poems and short stories to life! From comedies and dramas to mysteries and true stories, there are lots of writings for us to explore together! This class focuses on developing your reading comprehension and speaking skills, including pronunciation, intonation, and sharing your opinions about the writings. You'll also pick up lots of new vocabulary! 

📖 NOTE 1: This class requires reading, speaking, and listening skills.

📝 NOTE 2: There is no homework in this class. 

⏰ NOTE 3: If we don't finish a poem or short story during one lesson, we can finish it 
      together in the next lesson, or you're welcome to finish it on your own, and we'll 
      discuss your thoughts the next time we meet!

👩🏽‍🏫NOTE 4: All materials will be provided, however, you're always welcome to bring in your 
     own! If you're interested in this option, please message me in advance, or ask for details 
     in class.

pro_course_detail.title: Chatterbox (Conversation Class)
pro_course_detail.description:
A “chatterbox” is a person who talks A LOT. In fact, it may seem like they never STOP talking! 😂 In this new conversation class, we'll chat like friends! Maybe you want to learn American idioms and slang or share photos of a family event or recent vacation. Perhaps you have a YouTube channel and you need help writing or practicing your script. Whatever it is, let's make it FUN AND CASUAL! 

📖 NOTE 1: This class requires speaking and listening skills. Reading and writing may also 
      be incorporated depending on the discussion or activity. 

🚫 NOTE 2: Conversations should be light and casual. Please no inappropriate language 
      or content. 

🍿 NOTE 3: You’re welcome to bring snacks to our lessons!

pro_course_detail.title: Creative Writing (Writing Class)
pro_course_detail.description:
Do you dream of writing romantic poems in English or a science fiction short story? How about a dramatic script with memorable characters? Maybe you have a YouTube channel or a blog and want your content to sound like a native English speaker. If you like to write and want to improve your storytelling skills, then I invite you join me in the Creative Writing class!

📝 HOW IT WORKS:
      1. Write a poem, short story, script, etc. outside of class or during our lesson.
      2. I'll help you make corrections and suggest alternative phrases, sentence structures, 
         and vocabulary to elevate your work!

🤔 NEED SOME IDEAS? 
      When you book this class, you'll get access to the Creative Writing folder in the 
      Classroom Google Drive where you'll discover lots of exciting writing prompts to 
      inspire your imagination, such as music, sound effects, lines of dialogue, and more!

Happy writing; I can't wait to read your work!
